subject: Learning Methods
title: Goal Gradient Effect
description: Learn Goal Gradient Effect in one minute.

hook.text: Coffee shop customers with 12-stamp loyalty cards that had 2 stamps already completed the card faster than those.

buildup.text: The goal gradient effect: effort increases as you get closer to the finish.

discovery.text: For learning, this means breaking a large goal into smaller milestones. Each completed milestone creates a new.

twist.text: The effect also explains why people quit at the start when the goal feels distant.

climax.text: Break your learning plan into small checkpoints. Celebrate each one. As you approach each finish, motivation naturally.

punchline.text: Small milestones create proximity. Proximity creates speed.

quiz.question: How does the goal gradient effect influence motivation?
options: People lose motivation as they get closer to the goal
Effort increases as proximity to the goal increases
Distant goals are easier to achieve than close ones
